verdict.rationale: Asana has a broad, resource-oriented REST API. It comes with a published OpenAPI spec, webhooks, official JavaScript and Python SDKs, an official MCP server with read and write tools, and even newer surfaces like an AI Teammates (agents) endpoint. That points to wide programmatic coverage, but nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage matrix, evidence that UI-only areas (e.g. AI Studio no-code rules, Dash, AI Teammate configuration, app components) are fully exposed via the API, and independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.
